hypothesis: Classic chart 'shapes' (coiled-range breakouts, base-defense asymmetry, volume-climax co-occurrence, ATR-relative compression, staircase basing, measured-move overshoot) carry within-direction ranking signal on the 5-bar triple-barrier R outcome beyond the 10 standard META_FEATURE_KEYS, because they are nonlinear interactions/ratios among stored geometry and volume fields that the current linear ridge model on additive terms cannot express. Each candidate is tested alone, in a combined model added to the standard 10, and via drop-one ablation of the combined model, all through the SAME purged walk-forward harness and 6-gate acceptance the production ranking model uses. This is explicitly the 'nonlinear interactions' research thread flagged as next-in-line in scanner/research/experiments/20260710_sprint/SPRINT_REPORT.md, after loss-function iteration on the linear model was closed (0/48 cells passed) and ahead of the still-open Kronos-feature backfill.

data.direction_scope: bullish only (mirrors e1_robust_r / the standing take-all-bullish policy; bearish is a separate, smaller population and out of scope for this scaffold)
data.record_schema_note: Each record stores only the ~61 scalar fields extract_edge_features() computes at decision time (scanner/edge/features.py) - no raw per-bar OHLCV is persisted in the index or cached anywhere in this repo.

feature_availability_finding.reasoning: All 6 candidate pattern features below are pure functions of fields already present in every record's `features` dict (box_top/box_bottom-derived geometry, top_touches/bottom_touches, volume_expansion, volume_percentile, atr_value, doctrine_v2_box_stack_score, range_compression_ratio, breakout_strength_pct, abs_breakout_distance_pct, box_width_pct, latest_close). Each of those inputs is itself computed inside extract_edge_features() from bars up to and including the decision bar, so no candidate introduces look-ahead or a new data dependency.

excluded_patterns.name: upper/lower wick-rejection ratio
excluded_patterns.reason_excluded: Requires per-bar OHLC (individual bar high/low/open/close) to measure wick length vs body. Not stored in the index; no local bar cache exists anywhere in this repo (verified: no bars/*.parquet, *.csv, or cache directory keyed by ticker+date). Bars are only ever fetched live from a paid provider at scan time.

excluded_patterns.name: gap state (open vs prior close)
excluded_patterns.reason_excluded: Same as above - the index stores only `latest_close` (one price), not the entry bar's open or the prior bar's close, so a literal gap cannot be reconstructed from stored fields.

feature_availability_finding.decision: Deliberately did NOT build a raw-bar loader for the two excluded patterns. Fetching ~11,055 historical (ticker, date) bar windows live from a provider would be slow, would burn API budget, and - critically - is NOT deterministic run-to-run (vendor history can be revised/backfilled), which violates this lab's no-randomness/reproducible-experiment convention and the isolation rule (experiments must not have live network side effects). The atr_relative_coil and breakout_snap_ratio candidates below cover an adjacent part of the same 'contraction / overshoot' hypothesis space using only stored fields, as a substitute axis - not a like-for-like replacement. If wick/gap signal specifically is wanted later, it requires a dedicated point-in-time bar cache built as its own prerequisite experiment, not an ad hoc live fetch inside a scoring cell.

candidate_features.hypothesis: Coiled-spring thrust: a breakout of a given strength coming out of an unusually tight prior range carries more continuation energy than the same-strength breakout out of a loose range - a ratio a linear model holding the two terms additively cannot express.

Wyckoff-style base-defense asymmetry: a bullish base whose floor was tested/held more often than its ceiling before breaking out signals firmer accumulation and should predict stronger follow-through than one where the ceiling saw more of the pre-breakout action.

Climax/thrust volume shape: rows high on BOTH volume_expansion (vs recent average) AND volume_percentile (vs recent history) at once mark synchronized participation that either dimension alone - used linearly, as today - cannot isolate.

NR7/inside-bar-style compression measured against the stock's own absolute volatility (ATR-as-percent-of-price) rather than against its own recent range (which range_compression_ratio already covers). A base tight relative to typical daily movement is a truer coil than one merely tight relative to its own possibly-already-quiet history.

Staircase-base shape: rows that are BOTH already-stacked (multiple prior validated bases) AND currently coiling proxy a maturing VCP/stage-2 staircase pattern, a joint read box_stack_score and range_compression_ratio don't capture when used separately.

Measured-move overshoot: a breakout that has already traveled a large fraction of its own base height at signal time proxies for a partially pre-spent measured-move target - classic TA treats this as a chase-risk flag distinct from raw breakout_strength_pct alone.

harness.reused_from: scanner.edge.calibration.walk_forward_calibration skeleton, generalized over an arbitrary feature-key tuple the way 20260710_sprint/e3_features/run_experiment.py generalized its tail_prob harness (this experiment uses the expected_r/ridge objective instead, matching e1_robust_r)
harness.purge_days_source: scanner.config.EDGE_EMBARGO_DAYS (hardened from 9 to 11 calendar days on 2026-07-10, commit 9b55138; this scaffold reads the live constant rather than hardcoding a value so it can never silently drift stale)
harness.objective: expected_r (L2 ridge on raw R-multiple, closed-form _fit_ridge)

sanity_check.description: MANDATORY pre-flight, run every time before any cell is trusted: run the repo's own scanner.edge.calibration.walk_forward_calibration(direction='bullish', objective='expected_r') fresh, then run this file's generalized harness restricted to the standard 10 keys (STANDARD_10 == META_FEATURE_KEYS, zero pattern features involved) and require the two rank ICs to match within +/-0.005. If they do not match, the harness is broken and the run aborts before any cell executes.
sanity_check.no_hardcoded_expected_ic: Deliberately NOT pinning a specific expected_ic/expected_n number here. E1's preregistration.json hardcoded -0.086/n=5764 from a purge=9 run; SPRINT_REPORT.md later documents that number went stale the moment the purge window was hardened to 11 days ('the prereg file is deliberately left untouched - post-hoc edits to preregistrations are worse than stale targets'). This scaffold avoids repeating that failure mode by defining the check as a live self-consistency requirement (repo control vs. our reimplementation, computed at run time) rather than a number frozen before the purge change. This is a harness-fidelity check, not a peek at pattern signal: it uses zero pattern features.

cells.description: Standard 10 (META_FEATURE_KEYS) + all 6 pattern features (16 total). Tests whether adding the full pattern set to the production feature set improves on the standard-10 control.

acceptance_gates.note: Identical to the production ranking gate (scanner.edge.calibration.META_ACCEPT_*) and to e1_robust_r's gate. Not softened, not relaxed, no cell-specific carve-outs.

multiplicity.policy: 13 simultaneous OOF tests are run under this preregistration. Any single-cell pass must be reported with this multiplicity caveat attached - no cell is a standalone discovery. No multiplicity correction is applied to loosen or tighten the per-cell 0.07 IC gate itself; the ledger exists for honest reporting, not to change acceptance.

reporting_rule: Report ALL 13 cells regardless of outcome. No dropping losers, no cherry-picking the combined model over the solos or vice versa. A cell that errors reports status:errored with the exception and traceback, never silently skipped or omitted.
hard_rules: No gate weakening: acceptance thresholds above are frozen and identical to production; they may not be loosened after seeing results.

No peeking: no candidate feature's correlation with outcomes was computed before this file and experiment.py existed. The 6 hypotheses above were written from feature semantics and chart-pattern literature, not from any OOF or in-sample run.
No scored pattern cell runs until this preregistration is reviewed - experiment.py's --run-cells flag defaults to OFF specifically to enforce this.
Deterministic: no randomness anywhere (no RNG seeds needed - ridge is closed-form; tercile_lift's day-block bootstrap uses the repo's own fixed seed=7 default).
Isolation: only ADD files under scanner/research/experiments/20260711_chart_patterns/. Read-only against scanner/. No writes to scanner/reports or scanner/models. No scanner.main execution.
OOF only: no in-sample metric is ever reported as evidence.
